updated: Done, we saved the account changes.
activation_code_regenerated: Done, we issued a new invitation. Check whether the email went out.
last_admin: You cannot deactivate your own account: the company would be left with nobody to assign the work.
responsibles_group_invalid: The “Responsables” group of your company is not led by an administrator, so it cannot hold managers. Pick another managers group.
not_activated: This person has not activated their account yet. Meanwhile you can resend the invitation.
already_active: This account is already activated: it does not need another invitation.
limit_reached: Your company has reached the number of users it contracted. Deactivate an account or ask to raise the limit.
has_assignments: They have assigned controls: the ones they run will have no executor and the ones they own no owner. Confirm to continue.
responsible_has_delegates: This manager still has active or pending delegates on their team. Move them to another team or deactivate them first.
team_leader_inactive: This delegate's manager is no longer active. Move the delegate to another team before reactivating them.
